editions.title: Cloudflare opened the hood on its agent browser engine
editions.excerpt: Kitesurf, an experimental browser engine built for AI agents, is now open source. You can read it, run it, or host your own copy on Workers.

editions.title: The harness is not the model.
editions.excerpt: A read-only audit for the layer between your editor and your model provider. Includes a runnable script and a prompt for your coding agent.
